content: By adding the complexity of language and the fact that emotion expressions are very complex and context dependant BIBREF6 , BIBREF7 , BIBREF8 , we can see why detecting emotions in textual data is a challenging task. This difficulty can be seen when human annotators try to assign emotional labels to the text, but using various techniques the annotation task can be accomplished with desirable agreement among the annotators BIBREF9 .
